schema.text: Do you rarely cycle because you feel unsafe cycling (traffic, crime or harassment)?

ar.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: هل تعود قلّة ركوبك الدراجة إلى شعور بعدم الأمان عند ركوبها (حركة المرور أو الجرائم أو التحرش)؟

de.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Fahren Sie selten Rad, weil Sie sich beim Radfahren unsicher fühlen (Verkehr, Kriminalität oder Belästigung)?

en.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Do you rarely cycle because you feel unsafe cycling (traffic, crime or harassment)?

fa.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: آیا کم دوچرخه‌سواری می‌کنید چون هنگام دوچرخه‌سواری احساس امنیت نمی‌کنید (ترافیک، جرم یا آزار)؟

fr.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Faites-vous rarement du vélo parce que vous ne vous sentez pas en sécurité à vélo (circulation, délinquance ou harcèlement) ?

hu.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Azért kerékpározik ritkán, mert kerékpározás közben nem érzi magát biztonságban (forgalom, bűncselekmények vagy zaklatás)?

it.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Vai poco in bici perché in bici non ti senti al sicuro (traffico, criminalità o molestie)?

tr.#Do you rarely cycle because you feel un: Bisiklet sürerken kendinizi güvende hissetmediğiniz için mi (Trafik, suç veya taciz) nadiren bisiklet sürüyorsunuz?
